name: Garzapelta
isnote: PBDB places it in Stagonolepidoidea; its armour mixes features of the paratypothoracin Rioarribasuchus and of desmatosuchines (English Wikipedia), so it is left in Aetosauria without a finer placement here.
sum: Garzapelta is an aetosaur from the Late Triassic Cooper Canyon Formation of Texas, known mainly from associated osteoderms.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: An associated collection of osteoderms and some other bones such as ribs, from the UU Sand Creek locality (MOTT 3882), middle Cooper Canyon Formation, Texas; catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The holotype only, found in 1989 by Bill Mueller and Emmett Shedd.
biology: The sources consulted describe the armour but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Reyes et al. 2024
